text:
Aisha (CSM): Quick heads-up — NovaCommerce onboarding: we're seeing a pronounced tail on chat generate during peak flows (p95 ~820ms, p99 spikes ~1.2s). They do lots of short prompts (avg 12 tokens) and have a renewal review in ~6 weeks.

Aisha (CSM): Proposal: pilot compact-v2 quantized (int8) for 5% of traffic routed by prefix (short queries) and keep fallback to base-2 for long-context or failed quality checks. Goal: cut token-cost ~30% and reduce p95.

Tom (Eng): Can you paste the perf slice and a couple example prompts? I want to estimate batching/KV impact. Also any error-rate lift observed?

Aisha (CSM): p50 ~120ms, p95 ~820ms, p99 ~1200ms. Error rate steady <0.02%. Peak qps ~220 for 10m windows, short prompts dominate traffic at 64% of requests. Example prompts: "summarize this line item" and single-sentence completions.

Tom (Eng): OK. Sounds like a good candidate for compact int8. My suggested rollout: 5% traffic for 48h, canary checks: p50/p95, token cost delta, and semantic eval on our prompt set. Example config to start: 

```
route: prefix_short_prompts
split: 95/5
model_fallback: base-2
canary_duration: 48h
metrics: [p50_latency, p95_latency, cost_per_1k_tokens, quality_delta]
rollback_conditions:
  - p95 > baseline_p95 * 1.25
  - accuracy_drop > 2% on eval_set
```

Ravi (SRE): Add automated rollback triggers in the routing layer. Also warn that KV cache warmup may cause an initial latency spike; recommend weighted ramp: 1% -> 3% -> 5% over 6 hours. Rollback thresholds: p99 > 1.5s OR error_rate increase > 0.5pp. We should emit a deploy alert to #eng-oncall.

Lin (Product): Important to capture quality feedback from the customer. A/B test with blinded eval set (we can use their sample prompts + internal benchmarks). Let's define success as <=1.5% quality delta on our eval metrics and no regressions on hallucination checks. If metrics borderline, postpone swap and run targeted prompt templates.

Aisha (CSM): I'll run the customer eval pack and collect 50 seeded prompts for qualitative check. I'll also schedule an enablement call with NovaCommerce CS and ask them to flag any diffs.

Tom (Eng): I'll prepare the canary pipeline and a grafana dashboard with the three main panels: latency, success_rate, and cost_per_1k. Send me the exact prefix list for routing (Aisha).

Aisha (CSM): Sending list now via DM. Also noting renewal risk — if we can show stable perf + 20–30% cost improvement during trial, that's strong renewal leverage.

OpsBot: Created ticket TKT-4821 — "NovaCommerce: compact-v2 int8 canary (5%)" assigned to Tom. Link: https://redwood.example/tickets/TKT-4821

Ravi (SRE): I'll subscribe #eng-oncall and add runbook snippet: 
```
if p95 > baseline * 1.25 or p99 > 1.5s: -> rollback route, notify #customer-success, open incident if error_rate > 0.5pp
```

Lin (Product): Also capture customer NPS/qual feedback after 48h canary — put a short survey in the enablement call.

Aisha (CSM): Perfect. I'll also capture qualitative notes and forward any flagged prompts to Eng. Planning kick-off tomorrow 10:30am PT. :thumbsup:

Tom (Eng): 👍 I'll have the canary PR ready for review before the call.

Ravi (SRE): 👍 adding synthetic traffic to mimic peak qps during canary to stress test KV warmup.

Aisha (CSM): Thanks team — I'll drop a follow-up thread with the eval snapshots and the rollout timeline after the call.
